events.body: Just now, about 08:50, one of your vans (PV-2823 on the side) cut in on a lad on an e-scooter outside my shop on Linden Parade. He went into the kerb and fell, got up and seemed ok, scooter looked bent. Van carried on. Ulric from the bakery next door saw it too. I'm happy to talk to someone.

Road incident report: van PV-2823, Linden Parade, Coldharbour, about 08:50 today. Witness Delphine Ormsby (Ormsby's Hardware) reports the van cut in on an e-scooter rider, who hit the kerb and fell, got up, scooter appeared bent; van continued. She says a second witness, Ulric at the bakery next door, also saw it. Both are willing to speak to you.

Logged as SI-5943. I've spoken to Delphine Ormsby and to Ulric Normanton at Fallowmere Bakery this morning and have both accounts. Driver's report is in. Nothing further needed from the desk on this one, and no need to forward repeat reports from these two witnesses.

Morning. Delphine next door said she'd emailed you about the van and the scooter lad outside ours around ten to nine. Just to say I saw it too, same as her, van came in tight and he went into the kerb. Your safety person already rang me and I've told her all that. Just letting you know, nothing else needed.
